article_terms: Retained author-hosted manuscript: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; publication-date placeholder, not asserted identical to final publisher PDF.
code_terms: Inspected files carry upstream MIT notices where present; no root license for complete author supplement established. No upstream code executed or redistributed.
